title: MV Hondius passengers all evacuated with at least seven confirmed cases
summary: All of the passengers have now been evacuated from a cruiseship hit by an outbreak of the hantavirus. The MV Hondius had been docked in the Spanish Island of Tenerife; it will now head to the Netherlands.
